business_summary: A direct-to-consumer brand selling fast chargers, power banks, and cables priced between $20 and $60, targeting everyday phone and laptop users.
product: Fast chargers, power banks, and cables
stated_claims: We want phone-and-laptop users, and I'd say everyone qualifies.

relevant_tags.why: Charging accessories are utility-driven, convenience purchases for everyday life.
Tech accessories in the $20-60 range are common stocking stuffers or small gifts.
Targeting laptop and phone users aligns with working professionals.

note_signals.why: Their audience consists of 'tech-adjacent urban professionals' who are the ideal demographic for phone and laptop charging accessories.
High-frequency, impulse-friendly shoppers align well with a low-friction $20-60 utility purchase.
Older affluent women with lower impulse buying habits are less likely to convert on quick tech accessory offers.

gate_reason: The product type, price point, and target audience are clearly defined, allowing us to map them to relevant publishers immediately.
